item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena prepares two natural indicators at home: rose petal extract and turmeric paper. She wants to compare two household liquids, soap solution and lemon juice, to find out which is acidic and which is basic.

Which procedure gives a fair test?

options.A: Add one drop of rose extract to soap solution and ten drops of rose extract to lemon juice, using the same indicator for both.
options.B: Test soap solution with rose extract and lemon juice with turmeric paper, then compare the colours.
options.C: Add equal drops of the same rose extract to equal amounts of both liquids and record the final colour in each case.
options.D: Add rose extract to both liquids and compare only the final colour of the lemon juice with the starting colour of the soap solution.
